tests.name: bson_one_pass_basic_object
tests.intent: Probes to_bson() single-pass writing on a simple flat object with various primitive types.

tests.name: bson_one_pass_nested_containers
tests.intent: Probes single-pass BSON generation with deeply nested objects and arrays.

tests.name: bson_two_pass_fallback_vector_ref
tests.intent: Probes to_bson() overload taking an explicit vector reference, which forces the two-pass fallback path.

tests.name: bson_two_pass_stream_output
tests.intent: Probes to_bson() writing to an output adapter stream, exercising the two-pass behavior.

tests.name: bson_error_handler_replace
tests.intent: Probes single-pass fallback behavior when error handler is set to replace ill-formed UTF-8.

tests.name: bson_error_handler_ignore
tests.intent: Probes single-pass behavior when error handler is set to ignore invalid characters.

tests.name: bson_error_handler_strict
tests.intent: Probes exception handling under strict error handler for invalid key strings in single-pass.

tests.name: bson_zero_byte_in_key
tests.intent: Probes rejection of null characters (U+0000) inside object keys during single pass.

tests.name: bson_array_fixed_entries
tests.intent: Probes specialized writing of arrays containing homogeneous primitive numbers/booleans/nulls.

tests.name: bson_binary_values
tests.intent: Probes BSON serialization of binary data values with various subtypes.

tests.name: bson_discarded_value
tests.intent: Probes handling of discarded values inside objects during single-pass serialization.

tests.name: bson_empty_containers
tests.intent: Probes BSON generation for empty objects and empty arrays.

tests.name: bson_large_array_indices
tests.intent: Probes single-pass index boundary expansion in arrays with many elements.

tests.name: bson_invalid_binary_subtype
tests.intent: Probes exception handling when binary subtype exceeds valid limits.

tests.name: bson_mixed_array_types
tests.intent: Probes arrays containing mixed types (objects, arrays, strings, numbers) forcing non-fixed layout.

tests.name: bson_integer_limits
tests.intent: Probes single-pass serialization of integer values at the boundaries of 32-bit and 64-bit limits.

tests.name: bson_multiple_keys_ordering
tests.intent: Probes single-pass BSON serialization on objects with numerous keys to check order and structure integrity.

tests.name: bson_utf8_validation_keys
tests.intent: Probes strict UTF-8 validation checks on object keys during single-pass BSON writing.

tests.name: bson_deeply_nested_arrays
tests.intent: Probes deeply nested array structures processed via single-pass BSON writer.

tests.name: bson_roundtrip_equivalence
tests.intent: Probes equivalence between single-pass to_bson() and explicit vector reference two-pass to_bson().

tests.name: test_sink_written_and_single_pass_traits
tests.intent: Instantiate templates and verify detection of sink_written_t, bson_integers_fit_64_bits, and bson_single_pass_sink traits using explicit json to_bson generation.

tests.name: test_array_fixed_entries_break
tests.intent: Exercise the break condition within the fixed-size array writing loop in single pass when an array of homogeneous integers reaches the end completely.

tests.name: test_output_adapter_char_overwrite_static_assert
tests.intent: Ensure that output adapter using char type instantiates and successfully runs character-level writing and code paths leading to overwrite routines.

tests.name: test_bson_entry_fits_overflow_fallback
tests.intent: Trigger a scenario where the calculated BSON container or entry size approaches or exceeds INT32_MAX, forcing the single pass to return false and fallback to two-pass writer.

tests.name: test_nested_container_close_and_else_branches
tests.intent: Exercise else branches for non-structured object entries and deeply nested container closing logic in single-pass BSON serialization.

tests.name: bson_invalid_binary_subtype_fixed
tests.intent: Probes exception handling when binary subtype exceeds valid limits.

tests.name: bson_roundtrip_equivalence_fixed
tests.intent: Probes equivalence between single-pass to_bson() and explicit vector reference two-pass to_bson().

tests.name: bson_invalid_binary_subtype_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Probes exception handling when binary subtype exceeds valid limits.
